title: Predispose
summary: PREDISPO'SE, verb transitive s as z. [pre and dispose.] 1. To incline beforehand; to give a previous disposition to; as, to predispose the mind or temper to friendship. 2. To fit or adapt previously;

inlines.v: PREDISPO'SE, verb transitive s as z. [pre and dispose.] 1. To incline beforehand; to give a previous disposition to; as, to predispose the mind or temper to friendship. 2. To fit or adapt previously; as, debility predisposes the body to disease.
